principle: Readiness describes current public data and model maturity, never truth, importance, or confidence in a historical claim.

civilization.label: Civilization
civilization.why: Comparative profiles exist, but institutional, archaeological, environmental and historical coverage are not yet equally federated.

belief.label: Belief
belief.why: DRH and Pulotu provide meaningful comparative material, but DRH question crosswalk coverage remains sparse.
blocked_inferences: private belief from text or artifact alone

ritual.label: Ritual
ritual.why: Ritual variables exist across current comparative sources, but archaeological and ethnographic harmonization remains incomplete.

mortuary.label: Mortuary
mortuary.why: NOEMA has strong site-specific examples, but global comparative mortuary coverage is not complete.
available: Qafzeh and La Ferrassie source-bounded moments

altered.label: Altered states
altered.why: Modern cognition and selected ethnographic evidence exist, but cross-cultural historical harmonization is early.

technology.label: Technology
technology.why: Selected archaeological technology observations exist, but technology is not yet broadly federated across time and societies.

environment.label: Environment
environment.why: Environmental context is conceptually modeled but paleoclimate federation is not yet active at the level needed for causal analysis.

language.label: Language
language.why: Language identifiers are present in comparative data, but full tree-aware phylogenetic modeling is not yet active.

ancestry.label: Ancestry
ancestry.why: Ancient-DNA reasoning guards exist, but a broad individual-level aDNA federation is not yet integrated into the public analysis layer.
